cohort: 117 pregnant women undergoing elective caesarean delivery with combined spinal-epidural anesthesia
finding: The median effective dose (ED50) and 90% effective dose (ED90) of weight-based fixed-rate metaraminol infusions for preventing spinal-anesthesia-induced hypotension were 0.64 mug/kg/min and 2.00 mug/kg/min, respectively.
